claim_text: In mouse models of MPNST, biallelic Nf1 inactivation is not sufficient for tumor formation and requires cooperating genetic changes such as loss of Trp53, Pten, or Suz12 (PRC2).
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Nat Rev Dis Primers 2017; not in PMC). Statement made by the Gutmann 2017 Primer citing ref 61 Gregorian 2009 PMID 19846776; ref 62 Keng 2012 PMID 22700876; ref 63 Cichowski 1999 PMID 10591652; ref 68 Lee 2014 PMID 25240281; ref 69 De Raedt 2014 PMID 25119042. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.The review also notes that complete Trp53 or Pten loss may not be required (refs 64, 65).
